name: permits_geocoded
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL

name: permits_geocoded_at_set
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE geocoded_at IS NOT NULL

name: lat_xor_lng_null_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE (latitude IS NULL) <> (longitude IS NULL)

name: geocoded_at_set_but_no_geo_id_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE geocoded_at IS NOT NULL AND (geo_id IS NULL OR geo_id = '')

name: zombie_target_population
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE (geo_id IS NULL OR geo_id = '') AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND geocoded_at IS NOT NULL

name: w1_guard_admitted_rows
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits p JOIN address_points ap ON ap.address_point_id = CASE WHEN p.geo_id ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.geo_id::INTEGER END WHERE p.geo_id IS NOT NULL AND p.geo_id != '' AND p.geo_id ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (p.latitude IS DISTINCT FROM ap.latitude OR p.longitude IS DISTINCT FROM ap.longitude)

name: coords_outside_toronto_bbox_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND (latitude < 43.5 OR latitude > 43.9 OR longitude < -79.7 OR longitude > -79.1)

name: nonnumeric_geo_id_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE geo_id IS NOT NULL AND geo_id != '' AND geo_id !~ '^[0-9]+$'
